name: Claude Subagent Viewer
description: See, message and drive your Claude Code subagents from Orca's sidebar. macOS and Linux; needs tmux and Claude Code's tmux teammate mode.

cover.alt: Claude Subagent Viewer in Orca's right sidebar: four Claude Code subagents working live in a two-by-two grid, with a message bar below.

screenshots.alt: Orca with a Claude lead chat on the left and Claude Subagent Viewer on the right: four subagents in a grid, one of them working.
One subagent maximized inside the Claude Subagent Viewer panel, outlined in green because keys typed now go straight to it.
A narrower sidebar: the four subagents redraw to fit their smaller panes.
